settings.title: Pick ship to store at checkout
settings.body: Same order, same tires — you just choose the shop as the delivery address instead of your own. It is free, so nothing is added to your total for shipping.

settings.title: Your tires land at the shop
settings.body: The order ships from the distributor straight to Extreme Tires at 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd. They come off the truck and go on the rack with your name on them.

settings.title: You book a fitting
settings.body: Send us a day and an arrival window online, or call and a dispatcher writes it up. Book ahead of the delivery if you like — the shop will hold the set until you come in.

settings.title: They go on properly
settings.body: Mounted, balanced, torqued to your manufacturer's spec, TPMS handled and your old set taken away for recycling. You drive out on them.

settings.title: Nowhere to put four tires
settings.body: A set of four takes up most of a garage bay and they are heavy, awkward and filthy to move. Sending them to the shop means they never come off the truck at your house at all.

settings.title: No second trip
settings.body: Shipping home means loading the set back into your car and driving them somewhere anyway. Ship to store and delivery and installation are the same stop.

settings.title: Fitted by people who do it daily
settings.body: Extreme Tires mounts tires in Sunrise every working day. Balancing, TPMS relearns and torque specs are routine here, not an occasional job.

settings.title: The old set is our problem
settings.body: Your worn tires stay at the shop and get recycled. You are not stacking them by the bins or driving them to a disposal site.

settings.question: Does ship to store really cost nothing?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping to the Sunrise shop is free, the same as shipping to any address in the continental US. You still pay for the tires and, separately, for the installation when you come in.

settings.question: What does the installation itself cost?
settings.answer: Tire installation starts at $25 per tire and takes about 45–75 min for a set. What you actually pay depends on wheel size, run-flats, TPMS work and anything seized, and the shop confirms the total with you before a tool comes out.

settings.question: How will I know my tires have arrived?
settings.answer: The shop calls you when your order is checked in and on the rack. If you have already booked a fitting, they confirm that the set is there ahead of your appointment.

settings.question: Can I book the fitting before the tires get there?
settings.answer: Yes, and most people do. Book the appointment when you order and the shop will match it up with the delivery. If the shipment runs late, someone calls you to move the booking rather than leaving you to turn up for nothing.

settings.question: How long will the shop hold my tires?
settings.answer: Long enough for you to get in without rushing. If your schedule has gone sideways, call [phone] and say so — the rack space is not the problem, being left guessing is.

settings.question: Is ship to store available outside South Florida?
settings.answer: No. Ship-to-store means one shop: 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd, Sunrise, FL 33351. If you are anywhere else in the continental US your order ships to your address, and you take it to a fitter you trust.

settings.question: Can the van install them at my house instead?
settings.answer: If you are in the local install area, yes. The mobile van covers Sunrise, Plantation, Fort Lauderdale, Davie and the rest of the Broward cities listed on this page. Mobile fitting is a local bonus, not a national service.

settings.question: Can you install tires I did not buy from TireDrop?
settings.answer: Yes — the shop fits customer-supplied tires and wheels the same way. Book a tire installation appointment and bring them in, or have them shipped to the shop and mention it when you book so they know what to expect.
